## Outcome and change

Explain the requested outcome and the smallest complete change that achieves it.
Link the issue when useful. Distinguish new functionality from strengthened
existing behavior.

## Verification

- Commands run and results (retain failures/skips):
- User-facing adoption/update/rollback impact:
- Evidence for any numerical effectiveness claim:

## Checklist

- [ ] Public-safe examples; no private task records, credentials or user paths
- [ ] Relevant docs and optional Japanese explanation remain aligned
- [ ] Changed behavior has proportionate normal and counterexample coverage
- [ ] Changelog updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] Existing user configuration and records remain preserved

Mark irrelevant items with an explanation. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the complete
check commands; a checklist is not a substitute for the actual result.
